init_SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv: create a SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv instance to initialize the plate sliding back MuJoCo environment with default goal and hand bounds
step_SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv: run a single environment step on SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv with an action and receive observation, reward, and success info
compute_reward_SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv: compute the reward for a plate slide back task based on reach distance and pull distance metrics
reset_model_SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv: reset the SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv model to initial state with optional random object and goal position initialization
set_obj_xyz_SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv: set the object XYZ position in the SawyerPlateSlideBackEnv simulation by updating qpos and qvel state vectors
